research_question: Can genuinely new, free, point-in-time reconstructable public positioning information for COMEX Gold be acquired reproducibly before any forecast model is scored?

legacy_futures_only.provider: U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission Public Reporting Environment

disaggregated_futures_only.provider: U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission Public Reporting Environment

capture_rule: Fetch every weekly row for CFTC contract market code 088691 within the frozen window. Save raw API fields without outcome-based filtering.
pit_clock_rule_for_later_modeling: COT positions are Tuesday snapshots. To avoid same-Friday release timing ambiguity, a row may first be used from report_date + 6 calendar days (the following Monday or the next panel observation thereafter). This is intentionally conservative.
